positioning.p1: I architect and ship production AI for enterprises and scaling startups in highly regulated markets — automotive, banking, and pharma. Advanced RAG over vector and graph databases, and chatbots that scale to large organizations, built with security and observability from day one.
positioning.p2: As a consultant and fractional CTO I lead engineering teams, get IT processes in line, and take companies through penetration tests to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 — recently, all the way through to acquisition. I also teach teams to use AI properly: establishing process, automating quality control and security scanning (SAST, SCA, DAST), so your developers move ~5× faster without trading away quality.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: Quick answers to common questions. For more details, see the About, Projects, and Writing & Talks pages.

items.question: Who is Jacek Janczura?
items.answer: Jacek Janczura is an independent AI Architect, consultant, and fractional CTO. He co-founded Jaden Data GmbH and served as its CTO until 2024, and remains a shareholder and consulting partner — building secure, enterprise-grade AI for companies in highly regulated markets.

items.question: How do you make developers more productive with AI?
items.answer: By bringing AI into the development workflow the right way — pairing assistants and automation with strong guardrails: automated code review, security scanning (SAST, SCA, DAST), tests, and observability. Teams ship faster (often ~5×) without trading away quality or control.

items.question: What do you build?
items.answer: Enterprise LLM platforms, RAG systems over vector and graph databases, chatbots that scale, and event-driven cloud architectures — often as multi-tenant SaaS products integrated into real operations.

items.question: What scale have you operated at?
items.answer: Built platforms serving 50+ organizations, handling >1,000 concurrent connections and thousands of requests per second with high-throughput, event-driven microservices on AWS.

items.question: Which industries have you delivered for?
items.answer: Highly regulated markets in particular — automotive, banking and financial services, and pharmaceutical — plus manufacturing, venture capital, real estate, insurance, legal, e-commerce, telecommunications, energy/cleantech, logistics, and supply chain.

items.question: What is your experience with LLMs, RAG, and vector/graph databases?
items.answer: Designed and shipped enterprise LLM stacks across OpenAI/Azure/Bedrock/Mistral and pioneered RAG services with automated vector database creation using Pinecone, pgvector, and Milvus — plus graph-backed retrieval and evaluation/test frameworks to keep AI pipelines stable.

items.question: Do you work with security and compliance?
items.answer: Yes. I take companies through penetration tests and have delivered ISO 27001 and SOC 2 in ~3 months for enterprise platforms — recently as part of getting startups acquisition-ready. Multi-tenant security and RBAC are core architectural concerns in my work.

items.question: How can we work together?
items.answer: I take on fractional CTO and technical leadership, architecture reviews (cloud, LLM/RAG, security, scalability/cost), hands-on AI delivery, security/compliance programs, and AI enablement for engineering teams.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: Use the Contact page or reach out via LinkedIn. Share a short problem statement and your target timeline — I'll suggest the fastest way to help.
